Retaining Walls

Structure and stonework, considered together.

A retaining wall changes both the form and the flow of an outdoor space. We consider the grade, wall placement, adjacent pavers, and drainage details as part of the overall project plan. Seat walls, columns, and low borders can extend the same material language through the space.

  • Retaining walls coordinated with patios and walkways
  • Seat walls, columns, and low landscape borders
  • Attention to grade, drainage, and adjoining surfaces
  • Stone color and finish choices that fit the property
